name: Brine Hag — the creatures that dealt damage to it are picked and become 0/2
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "the base power and toughness of each creature that dealt damage to it this turn become 0/2" produced nothing: damage history is not tracked. _addAbilityPseudo now reads the phrase as "any number of target creatures" (a non-targeting pick), which the base-P/T parser already understood. Two creatures picked become 0/2; the third is untouched.
